description: The consumer half of library.update: which consumer manifests and lockfile pin the owner package, the unchanged consumer regression, and the complete delivery gates. The package identity and the versions come from the library-behavior-plan beside it, and the release from the tarball the run packs.

regression.description: What proves the consume: a consumer regression that fails before and passes after, or, for a presentation release the consumer exercises through no spec, the two audits of the surface that carry the same verdict (kind audit).

specRegression.description: A consumer test that exists at the base, fails against the installed version and passes against the release: the ordinary proof, and the only one for a package whose behaviour a consumer can call.

auditRegression.description: The before-and-after authority of a presentation release the consumer exercises through no spec of its own: two interface.audit branches of this session, the first at the served head the consumer still runs and the second at the head this branch bumped, and the family-owned claims that fail on the first and pass on the second. It is lawful only where the bound library-release names a family, because only there is the repaired behaviour unreachable except by rendering it.

claims.description: The rule identifiers of the family-owned claims the release repairs: each one fails on the before-audit, routed to the family owner as a grammar gap, and passes on the after-audit.

before.description: The interface.audit branch of this session that measured the surface at the installed version.

after.description: The interface.audit branch of this session that measured the same surface at the version this branch bumped to.
